bulk_directories.pattern: PHP, JS, CSS, JSON, XML, images (complete WordPress installation)
bulk_directories.description: Complete WordPress installation for brubru.world marketing website. Tracked in git but treated as bulk due to size (19,756 files). Includes core WordPress files, plugins (Elementor page builder, Elementor Pro, WPML multilingual CMS, Yoast SEO, SiteGround Security, SiteGround Cache, Code Snippets, WPML String Translation), twentytwentyfive theme, and all language/locale files for 40+ languages.
Production build output from Vite bundler. Deployed to SiteGround brubru.beresol.eu. Includes 9 pre-rendered HTML routes for AI crawlers and JS chunks for React app.

Catalan EU legislation translation output. Each subdirectory is a CELEX number containing index.html with the full translated legal text. Generated by backend/scripts/catalan_translate.py using Softcatala NMT engine. Gitignored - uploaded directly to SiteGround via FileZilla.

European Commission DG organigrammes. 35 DGs covered with PDF source files and parsed JSON containing staff contacts, reporting lines, and organisational structure. Used by chatbot for EU institutional knowledge.
EU public procurement reference data. eForms notice subtypes (51 types), eCertis evidence types, TED codelists for the EU Tenderator feature. Sourced from EU Publications Office open data.

Alembic database migration history for PostgreSQL schema evolution. 43 revision files covering all tables: users, chats, amendments, eu_laws, rss_feeds, eu_calendar_events, eprs_publications, committee_work, predictions, and more.

bulk_directories.pattern: reports/*.html (11 Beresol reports), monitors/**/*.md|*.json (7 policy monitors)
bulk_directories.description: Beresol Knowledge Bundle - 11 open EU policy reports and 7 continuously updated monitors (AI Monitor, CMU, Defence, Gold, Startup, Tariff, VCAngel). Always cited as "Beresol Open Report/Monitor" with beresol.eu/public-affairs attribution. Loaded via beresol_knowledge_loader.py.

bulk_note: brubru.world (19,756 WordPress files), data/legislacio-ue-catala (554 Catalan translation HTML files), backend/knowledge_base/brubru-knowledge-bundle (127 Beresol knowledge files), backend/knowledge_base/ec_organigrammes (109 DG organigramme files), backend/knowledge_base/tenders (98 EU procurement data files), frontend/dist (88 Vite build output files), backend/migrations (45 Alembic migration files) are listed as bulk_directories and excluded from the main files array.
